note: Neon League items, batch 3 of 5 (DC-N3): the rest of the opening pool, written and landed together by E18-C17. Four Charms and two tactical cards, all initial from Division 1. Dry Side reads the side of the lane the ball rolled (roll.left_side), Lane Reader the match's lane (condition.lane) and Hook Shot is a one-throw hook scale (tactical.hook_scale); the others use existing rule pieces. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: +4 Mult when a roll in the frame was left of the centre board where it crossed 34 ft (the line where Two-Tone's left oil ends). Nothing for a ball that stayed on the right.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A split lane strip, its left half lit, that marks the ball's side as it passes 34 ft; the Mult shows in the explanation.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a strike when the match's lane is not House Oil (Long Oil, Two-Tone or Dry Backend). Nothing on House Oil, and nothing on a spare or an open frame.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: An oil-pattern chart that shows the match's lane and lights on a strike off House Oil.

design.trigger: Played with a throw: that roll's charge hooks 1.5× as far, on top of the ball and any modification. The card is spent with the throw, whatever it knocks down.
design.pool: Shop tactical slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A curved arrow that stretches over the aim guide while the card is armed; the guide bends further.

design.trigger: Played with a throw: +4 Mult when no roll in the frame was curved. A curved roll in the frame, either one, and it gives nothing; the card is spent either way.
design.pool: Shop tactical slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A straight chalk line drawn down the lane while the card is armed; it holds if the frame stays straight.

design.trigger: +$3 after the frame banks when a roll in it rebounded off the gutter edge (Bumper Guard). Nothing in a frame without a rebound.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A coin that springs off a bumper when a rebound happens; the payout shows in the explanation.

design.trigger: +$2 after the frame banks when it is a strike with no curved roll. Nothing for a curved strike, a spare or an open frame.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A banknote folded into a straight crease; it pays out on a straight strike.
